consequence.statement: When ingress-shim runs with --extra-certificate-annotations set, the listed annotation keys are copied from Ingress-like resources onto the resulting Certificate objects; environments that do not set the flag are unaffected.

assertion.statement: Release 1.18.0 adds the ingress-shim option --extra-certificate-annotations, which sets a list of annotation keys to be copied from Ingress-like resources to the resulting Certificate object.
